entities.name: Timer T3565
entities.description: Timer used during notification procedure completion. Stopped upon reception of SERVICE REQUEST, CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST, REGISTRATION REQUEST messages, NGAP UE context resume request indication, or NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that triggers stopping of timer T3565 and initiation of service request procedure.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that triggers stopping of timer T3565 and initiation of service request procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message that triggers stopping of timer T3565 and initiation of registration procedure.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message received over non-3GPP access that triggers stopping of timer T3565 and notification to SMF about UE unreachability.

entities.name: PDU session status information element
entities.description: Information element included in NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message indicating PDU session status for local release procedures.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated when SERVICE REQUEST or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST messages are received.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated when REGISTRATION REQUEST message is received for mobility and periodic registration update.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE state
entities.description: 5GSM state indicating PDU session is inactive.

entities.name: No user-plane resources need to be re-established
entities.description: Condition where user-plane resources of PDU session(s) do not need re-establishment, triggering SMF notification.

entities.name: Local release of PDU sessions
entities.description: Action performed by AMF to locally release PDU sessions based on PDU session status information.

entities.name: Request SMF to perform local release
entities.description: Action where AMF requests SMF to perform local release of PDU sessions.

relations.description: Reception of SERVICE REQUEST message stops timer T3565
Reception of CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message stops timer T3565
Reception of REGISTRATION REQUEST message stops timer T3565
Reception of NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message stops timer T3565
NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message may contain PDU session status information element
PDU session status IE indicates whether PDU sessions are in INACTIVE state
Condition of no user-plane resources needing re-establishment triggers SMF notification
PDU session status IE triggers local release of PDU sessions
PDU session status IE triggers request to SMF for local release
